description: Searches file contents using ripgrep with structured JSON output. Returns match locations with file, line, column, matched text, and line content.

fixedStrings.description: Treat pattern as a literal string instead of regex (--fixed-strings)

invertMatch.description: Show lines that do NOT match the pattern (--invert-match)

maxCount.description: Maximum matches per file to stop rg early (--max-count)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 1000)

multiline.description: Allow patterns to span multiple lines (--multiline)

noIgnore.description: Don't respect .gitignore and other ignore files (--no-ignore)

path.description: Directory or file to search in

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for

sort.description: Sort results by the specified criterion (maps to --sort TYPE)

type.description: Filter by file type (e.g., 'ts', 'js', 'py', 'rust'). Maps to --type TYPE.

name: search
title: Code Search
